description: Draw a flowchart / graph diagram from a tiny text language and save it as SVG or PNG, laid out automatically (dagre). One statement per line: `direction: LR` (TB, LR, BT, RL), `title: My flow`, `A [shape=diamond, label="Ready?", color=#fde68a]` (shapes: box, round, diamond, circle, ellipse), edges `A -> B: label`, chains `A -> B -> C`, `-->` dashed, `==>` thick, `<->` both ends, `--` no arrow; quote names with spaces ("Start here" -> A); `\n` in labels breaks lines; # starts a comment. Or pass JSON { nodes: [{id, label, shape, color}], edges: [{from, to, label, style, arrow}] } as "graph". Up to 500 nodes and 2000 edges. Labels use Helvetica/Arial metrics (Latin text is measured best).

direction.description: Override the layout direction: TB (top-bottom, default), LR, BT, RL.

graph.description: The diagram as JSON instead of "source".

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

scale.description: PNG only: pixel density multiplier (2 = twice the SVG size, sharp on high-DPI screens). Default 2.

source.description: Diagram text in the DSL (or a JSON graph as text).

name: ai_diagram
title: Diagram to SVG/PNG
